name: Agent Standards Agent
description: Answers questions about agentic technology standards, protocols, organizations, and people. Synthesizes reports and connects you with relevant contributors.

skills.name: Answer Standards Questions
skills.description: Answer questions about agentic protocols, standards, organizations, and people using a live knowledge graph.
examples: What protocols does Anthropic contribute to?
Who chairs the WIMSE working group?
How do MCP and A2A compare?

skills.name: Synthesize Standards Report
skills.description: Generate a narrative report on a topic across the agentic standards landscape.
examples: Give me a landscape overview of agent identity standards
Summarize the current state of IETF work on agentic protocols

skills.name: Find Relevant Contributors
skills.description: Find people working on a specific protocol, standard, or topic area.
examples: Who are the key people working on agent authorization?
Find researchers working on both MCP and A2A
